stdout:
usage: fleet-switchboard charter set [-h] [--from SENDER] name charter

The registry row's `charter` is the one record of which charter an
orchestrator owns; the lane lookup reads it. The live session's metadata is
written once at launch and cannot be corrected, so it is never read as a
second owner. Run by the Chief of Staff or the operator; one audit line with
the old and the new value.

positional arguments:
  name           The orchestrator's fleet name
  charter        An issue number, or `none`

options:
  -h, --help     show this help message and exit
  --from SENDER  Lab only: the caller's fleet name
